description_it: Patate croccanti fuori e morbide dentro, aromatizzate al rosmarino fresco.
description_en: Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside potatoes flavored with fresh rosemary.
steps_it: Lavare e tagliare le patate a spicchi.
Condire con olio, sale e rosmarino.
Cuocere in forno a 200°C per 35 minuti.
steps_en: Wash and cut potatoes into wedges.
Season with oil, salt and rosemary.
